sources.title: Ornith-1.0: Self-Scaffolding LLMs for Agentic Coding
sources.evidence: June 2026 announcement explicitly includes a 31B Dense member of Ornith-1.0, a family intended for agentic coding and trained with joint scaffold/solution optimization. The current page reports results only for 9B, 35B and 397B.

sources.title: Original Ornith-1 README at June 25, 2026 commit
sources.evidence: Original developer README explicitly lists 31B-Dense with the other Ornith-1.0 variants and states MIT licensing. Citation credits DeepReinforce Team. Detailed reasoning, context and tool-serving examples concern Ornith-1.0-9B, not 31B.

sources.title: Current official Ornith repository README
sources.evidence: Current checkpoint table lists only 9B, 35B and 397B for Ornith-1.0. Its 262144-token context and reasoning/tool-parser documentation describes shipped checkpoints; 31B has no row or serving recipe. Both generations are described as MIT licensed.

sources.title: Official Ornith-1.0 weights collection
sources.evidence: Collection linked directly from the developer announcement contains 9B, 35B and 397B checkpoints and quantizations, with no 31B checkpoint at review time.

sources.title: Official organization public model listing
sources.evidence: Live public organization listing contains no Ornith-1.0-31B. The old deepreinforce-ai organization query and an exact Ornith-1.0-31B search returned empty arrays. Absence does not prove the model never existed.

sources.title: Exact 31B model metadata endpoint, inaccessible
sources.evidence: Exact new-organization metadata endpoint returned HTTP 401; the deepreinforce-ai equivalent also returned 401. No exact-model metadata or public model card was obtained.

sources.title: Exact 31B configuration endpoint, inaccessible
sources.evidence: Returned HTTP 401. Configuration and exact learned architecture dimensions could not be inspected.

sources.title: Exact 31B tensor index endpoint, inaccessible
sources.evidence: Returned HTTP 401. No shard filenames or tensor headers were available, so complete learned-weight counting and buffer/quantization checks were impossible; no weight shards were downloaded.

sources.title: Ornith-1.5: From Self-Scaffolding to Self-Improvement
sources.evidence: Later first-party article covers 9B, 35B and 397B and compares their Ornith-1.0 versions. It contains no Ornith-1.0-31B total/active parameter table or new 31B specification; Gemma4-31B comparison entries refer to a different model.

sources.title: Official repository README history
sources.evidence: The README announcing the family including 31B was committed on June 25, 2026 (16d32b11211ac83373d37dc67234f77e77f909a1). This dates the announcement text, not a demonstrated public 31B weight release.

name.note: Display-name normalization of the announced Ornith-1.0 31B Dense variant.

developer.note: Original README credits DeepReinforce Team; the current repository and model organization are branded Ornith.

family.note: Explicit member of the Ornith-1.0 family.

release_date.note: Developer-announced release date: the June 25 README says the family is releasing today and explicitly lists 31B as available. Retain this last-documented announcement date despite current availability uncertainty; it does not prove a 31B checkpoint was downloadable.

open_weights.note: Original announcement calls the family open source, but current official distribution omits 31B and exact endpoints are inaccessible. Public availability is unverified, not established false.

license.note: Developer announces MIT for the family while explicitly including 31B. This is the announced license; no 31B checkpoint license file was available.

parameters_b.note: Nominal developer-announced size in billions, not an independently counted complete learned-weight total. No exact configuration/index/headers could be inspected.

active_parameters_b.note: No separately defined active-per-token count for this exact model in the announcement or later first-party comparisons. Dense architecture does not justify equating active and total parameters.

architecture.note: Explicitly announced as 31B Dense. Exact layer structure and Transformer implementation remain unverified without a model card/configuration; no sibling specification is transferred.

context_window.note: 262144 tokens is documented for shipped checkpoints; 31B is absent from their table, and its configuration is inaccessible. Clear the unsupported exact-variant baseline.

modalities.note: The developer announcement identifies this variant as a language model for generating coding solutions from tasks, supporting text input/output. Image support is not established for the exact 31B variant and is removed; no sibling visual processor is assumed.

reasoning.note: Reasoning-parser recipes apply to documented shipped models. No exact 31B card or template establishes a dedicated thinking mode.

tool_call.note: Agentic-coding intent alone does not establish a native tool-call serialization/interface for the absent 31B checkpoint.

description.value: Announced 31B dense Ornith 1.0 variant for agentic coding; public checkpoint availability remains unverified.
description.note: Replaces an availability/reasoning implication with the documented intended use and observed verification limit.

patch.description: Announced 31B dense Ornith 1.0 variant for agentic coding; public checkpoint availability remains unverified.
patch.notes: 31B Dense is an announced Ornith-1.0 variant, documented in June 25, 2026 family announcement text with a nominal 31B size and MIT license. June 25 is retained as the developer-announced release date; actual public checkpoint availability remains unverified: current official collection and repository checkpoint table omit it, public exact-name search finds none, and metadata/config/index endpoints return HTTP 401. No complete learned-weight count can be independently derived, and active parameters are not separately disclosed. Context, image input, dedicated thinking mode and native tool calling remain unverified for 31B; specifications of released 9B/35B/397B checkpoints are not inherited.

summary: Confirmed the developer-announced June 25, 2026 release, nominal 31B dense variant, developer/family and announced MIT license. No public exact-model checkpoint/card/config/index was accessible, and current first-party checkpoint lists omit 31B. Clear unsupported current open-weight availability, context, image-input, reasoning and tool-call assertions; retain active count as undisclosed. Actual checkpoint availability and exact learned total remain unresolved.
